pet_notes: Fearless little ladybug adventurer in a glossy red-and-black shell, open translucent wings, windswept purple scarf, gold compass charm, large violet eyes, and an eager forward-pointing pose; preserve the exact face, materials, markings, proportions, and silhouette from the reference.
style_notes: Polished 3D toy-like mascot rendering matching the reference; compact full-body sprite, transparent chroma background for deterministic cleanup, no text or scenery.
style_contract: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction. Style `auto`: Infer the most appropriate pet-safe style from the user request and reference images, then keep that exact style consistent across every row. User style notes: Polished 3D toy-like mascot rendering matching the reference; compact full-body sprite, transparent chroma background for deterministic cleanup, no text or scenery..
pet_safe_style: Pet-safe sprite: compact full-body mascot, readable in a 192x208 cell, clear silhouette, simple face, stable palette/materials, and crisp edges for chroma-key extraction.

source_reference.provenance: Copied byte-for-byte from the user-supplied attached reference image.

visual_decisions.personality: Fearless, eager, upbeat little adventurer who points toward the next destination and expects her companion to keep up.
visual_priorities: large violet eyes and expressive brows
glossy red-and-black shell with readable spots
forward-pointing hand and compact flying silhouette
animation_mannerisms: running uses a clear directional airborne gait
waving moves the existing arm with the hand attached
failed bows with embarrassed tired expression
running studies the compass while working
visual_decisions.direction_mechanics: Head, eye globes, eyelids, antennae, scarf, wings, and pointing arm turn together around a stable abdomen, legs, compass, and wing-root anchor; no whole-sprite rotation or skew.
visual_decisions.small_size: Preserve face, violet eyes, shell silhouette, scarf, wings, and compass at 60px; simplify secondary wing highlights before obscuring the face.
visual_decisions.palette: Glossy crimson and black shell, warm cream face and abdomen, luminous pale-gold translucent wings, saturated violet scarf and eyes, and gold compass accents.

generation_metadata.image_generation: Grounded imagegen strips generated from the supplied reference and canonical base, followed by deterministic extraction and assembly.
generation_metadata.standard_rows: All nine standard animation rows independently generated as grounded strips; every strip passed component extraction QA.
generation_metadata.look_rows: Rows 9 and 10 coherently synthesized in exact clockwise order from approved cardinal anchors; row 10 was regenerated after blind semantic review detected right-facing drift.
generation_metadata.running_left: Independently generated because scarf wind, pointing arm, wing arrangement, and compass charm are asymmetric; not mirrored.
generation_metadata.deterministic_assembly: assemble_extended_atlas.py with one final edge-local chroma despill pass.

direction_review.cardinal_review: All four cardinal directions pass hard gates.
direction_review.blind_review: Three isolated blind reviewers reached strict-majority pass for all 14 direction pairs, including hard 270 screen-left.
direction_review.continuity: Adjacent-direction continuity measured after final assembly; warnings are recorded in look-continuity.json.
